note: Hand-authored enrichment. Derived fields (endpoint, schemas, errors) always come from the spec; this file only adds business meaning, stable ids, risk/confirmation hints and synonyms. Matching is by operationId when present, otherwise by method+path.

actions.intent: Create a new contact (person) in the account, optionally assigning lists and attributes in the same call.
actions.when_to_use: When a new person must be added to the CRM and you know at least their email (or SMS number).
actions.when_not_to_use: Do not use to modify an existing contact — use contacts.update_contact. For a double opt-in flow use contacts.create_doi_contact.
preconditions: Valid API key with contacts write access
A unique email address that does not already exist in the account
side_effects: Adding lists can trigger automations or DOI emails
Consumes a contact slot in the plan quota

actions.intent: Update an existing contact's attributes or list membership, identified by email, id, SMS number or ext_id.
actions.when_to_use: When the person already exists and you need to change their data or list membership.
actions.when_not_to_use: Do not use for bulk changes — use contacts.update_batch_contacts.
preconditions: The contact must exist; otherwise the API returns 404

actions.intent: Permanently delete a contact by identifier.
actions.when_to_use: When a person must be erased from the account (e.g. a validated GDPR erasure request).
actions.when_not_to_use: Prefer blocklisting or unsubscribing when the goal is to stop sending emails but keep history.
preconditions: Irreversible: contact history and stats are removed
side_effects: Removes the person from all lists

actions.intent: Add one or more existing contacts to a specific list.
actions.when_to_use: When you already have contacts and want to put them in an audience list.
actions.when_not_to_use: Do not use to create contacts from scratch — create them first or use contacts.import_contacts.
preconditions: Contacts must be identifiable by email/id/ext_id

actions.intent: Bulk import contacts from a file (CSV) into lists, creating or updating them.
actions.when_to_use: When onboarding an existing audience from an external system.
actions.when_not_to_use: Do not use for a handful of contacts — use contacts.create_contact or contacts.update_batch_contacts.
preconditions: A CSV file must be uploaded first

actions.intent: Create a contact through a double opt-in (DOI) flow, sending a confirmation email before the contact becomes active.
actions.when_to_use: When consent must be proven and the signup source requires DOI.
actions.when_not_to_use: Do not use when explicit consent is already recorded — use contacts.create_contact.
preconditions: A DOI template must be configured
side_effects: Contact only becomes active after confirmation

actions.intent: Request an asynchronous export of contacts (all or a filtered subset) to a file.
actions.when_to_use: When you need a portable copy of contact data for analysis or migration.
actions.when_not_to_use: Do not poll aggressively — poll processes.get_process or wait for the webhook.
preconditions: Export scope (all contacts or a segment/filter) must be defined

actions.intent: Create an email marketing campaign with sender, subject, content and recipient targeting.
actions.when_to_use: When preparing a newsletter or promotional email to a list or segment.
actions.when_not_to_use: Do not use for one-to-one transactional messages — use transactional_email.send_transac_email.
preconditions: An authenticated sender or verified domain
At least one target list or segment
side_effects: If scheduledAt is set, scheduling begins

actions.intent: Update a draft or scheduled email campaign (content, recipients, sender, schedule).
actions.when_to_use: When editing a campaign that has not been sent yet, or rescheduling it.
actions.when_not_to_use: Do not expect to edit a campaign already sending; check its status first.
preconditions: Campaign must be in draft/scheduled/queued state

actions.intent: Send an existing email campaign immediately, ignoring its scheduled time.
actions.when_to_use: When a campaign is ready and must go out now.
actions.when_not_to_use: Do not use to send a test — use email_campaigns.send_test_email. Irreversible once sending starts.
preconditions: Campaign must exist and be sendable
side_effects: Sends real emails to the whole audience

actions.intent: Send a test version of a campaign to a small list of test addresses.
actions.when_to_use: Before launching, to verify rendering, links and personalization.
actions.when_not_to_use: Do not use for production delivery.
side_effects: Sends a small number of emails

actions.intent: Send an existing SMS campaign immediately.
actions.when_to_use: When an SMS campaign is approved and must go out now.
actions.when_not_to_use: Do not use for transactional OTP messages — use transactional_sms.

actions.intent: Create and send a WhatsApp marketing campaign using an approved template.
actions.when_to_use: When reaching opted-in contacts on WhatsApp with a pre-approved template.
actions.when_not_to_use: Do not use before the template is approved.
side_effects: Creates and may send a campaign

actions.intent: Send a transactional email to one recipient, optionally using a template, attachments and scheduling.
actions.when_to_use: For password resets, order confirmations, receipts and any 1:1 triggered email.
actions.when_not_to_use: Do not use for bulk marketing — use email_campaigns.

actions.intent: Send a transactional SMS (e.g. OTP or alert) asynchronously to a mobile number.
actions.when_to_use: For verification codes, alerts and 1:1 notifications.
actions.when_not_to_use: Do not use for marketing blasts — use sms_campaigns.

actions.intent: Send a transactional WhatsApp message (template or session message) to a contact.
actions.when_to_use: For order updates, OTPs and support replies on WhatsApp.
actions.when_not_to_use: Do not use for marketing campaigns — use whatsapp_campaigns.
preconditions: Approved template if outside the 24h window

actions.intent: Create a reusable email template for transactional or marketing messages.
actions.when_to_use: When the same email structure will be sent repeatedly with dynamic variables.
actions.when_not_to_use: Do not create a template for a one-off message — send inline htmlContent.

actions.intent: Create a sender identity (from name/email) that campaigns and transactional emails can use.
actions.when_to_use: When a new brand, domain or team needs its own From address.
actions.when_not_to_use: Do not use if the domain is not authenticated — deliverability will suffer.
preconditions: Access to the mailbox for OTP validation
side_effects: Creates a sender in pending state until validated

actions.intent: Trigger authentication checks for a sender domain (Brevo code, DKIM, DMARC).
actions.when_to_use: After DNS records are configured and before sending production traffic.
actions.when_not_to_use: Do not use repeatedly without changing DNS — check the returned configuration first.

actions.intent: Create a webhook that pushes Brevo events (email, SMS, marketing, CRM) to an HTTPS endpoint.
actions.when_to_use: When an external system must react to events in near real time instead of polling.
actions.when_not_to_use: Do not use when a simple pull/report is enough — polling may be cheaper.
preconditions: A public HTTPS endpoint that accepts POST
side_effects: Starts delivering events to the URL
External side effects in the receiver

actions.intent: Create a company record in the CRM.
actions.when_to_use: When adding an organization you sell to or track.
actions.when_not_to_use: Do not use to add a person — that is contacts.create_contact.
preconditions: Optional attributes defined in CRM settings

actions.intent: Create a deal (sales opportunity) attached to a pipeline and stage.
actions.when_to_use: When a sales opportunity must be tracked through the pipeline.
actions.when_not_to_use: Do not use for a simple task or note.

actions.intent: Update a deal, including moving it to another pipeline stage.
actions.when_to_use: When a deal progresses, changes value or needs corrected attributes.
actions.when_not_to_use: Do not use to create one — use crm.create_deal.

actions.intent: Create a task, optionally associated with a contact, company or deal.
actions.when_to_use: When a follow-up action must be assigned and tracked.
actions.when_not_to_use: Do not use for free-text history — use crm.create_note.
side_effects: Creates a task and notifies the assignee

actions.intent: Add a note to the history of a contact, company or deal.
actions.when_to_use: To record context that must be visible to the team.
actions.when_not_to_use: Do not use for actionable follow-ups — use crm.create_task.

actions.intent: Create a coupon collection that will hold generated discount codes.
actions.when_to_use: Before generating a batch of promo codes.
actions.when_not_to_use: Do not use to add codes to an existing collection — use coupons.create_coupons.

actions.intent: Generate a batch of coupon codes inside a collection.
actions.when_to_use: For promotions that need many unique codes.
actions.when_not_to_use: Do not use if the collection does not exist.

actions.intent: Create a payment request / payment link to collect money from a customer.
actions.when_to_use: When sending a payable link for an order or invoice.
actions.when_not_to_use: Do not use for internal bookkeeping — this creates a real payable object.

actions.intent: Create a loyalty program (points or cashback) with its rules and configuration.
actions.when_to_use: When launching a new rewards program.
actions.when_not_to_use: Do not use to update or publish an existing program.
preconditions: Loyalty feature enabled on the plan
side_effects: Creates a program in draft state
Must be published to go live

actions.intent: Create a reward that loyalty members can redeem with points or cashback.
actions.when_to_use: When adding a redeemable incentive to a loyalty program.
actions.when_not_to_use: Do not use to issue a voucher to a specific contact.
side_effects: Adds a reward to the program catalog

actions.intent: Create or update an order and its status in the eCommerce data model.
actions.when_to_use: When syncing store orders so Brevo can attribute revenue and trigger automations.
actions.when_not_to_use: Do not use for payment collection — use payments.

actions.intent: Track a custom event for a contact to feed segmentation and automation triggers.
actions.when_to_use: When recoding a behavioural action (e.g. viewed_product, completed_onboarding).
actions.when_not_to_use: Do not use for standard email events — those are tracked automatically.
side_effects: Adds an event to the contact timeline

actions.intent: Send a message as a human agent inside a Brevo conversation.
actions.when_to_use: When replying to a visitor or customer in the Conversations inbox.
actions.when_not_to_use: Do not use for marketing broadcasts.

actions.intent: Read the account profile, plan and core settings.
actions.when_to_use: As a safe connectivity/auth check or to discover plan limits before acting.
actions.when_not_to_use: Do not use as a health check in tight loops — respect rate limits.
